title.en: Australian politics live: Greens say big tech’s ‘audacity is gobsmacking’; growing risk of selling Sydney or Melbourne units at a loss
title.zh: 澳大利亚政治直播：兰比指责‘危险’的汉森如同特朗普；新南威尔士州一国党领袖要求‘停止’堕胎

summary.en: Live coverage of the day's political news in Australia, including comparisons of political figures to Donald Trump, calls to halt abortion access, and allegations of a 'pattern of behaviour' regarding the misuse of public funds for political advantage, specifically concerning a $6 million sports precinct upgrade...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚当日政治新闻的实时报道，包括将政治人物与唐纳德·特朗普进行比较，呼吁停止堕胎，以及关于滥用公共资金谋取政治利益的“行为模式”的指控，特别是涉及一项600万美元的体育综合体升级请求。

body.en: Follow the day’s news live Get our new political email , free app or daily news podcast Sports precinct funding report reveals a ‘pattern of behaviour’, Wilson says Tim Wilson says there are questions for Labor to answer over an ABC report which says health minister Mark Butler’s office asked an Adelaide council to put forward a $6m sports precinct upgrade for federal funding before any detailed costings or formal planning had been done. I think what we’re now seeing is a pattern of behaviour. The prime minister gave a grant to a golf course in his electorate just around the corner from his home, of which he was a member, which he failed to declare. Now we have the health minister, the next wannabe prime minister, doing exactly the same thing. That’s a difficult thing to do. However, I think one way to do it is to ensure that Muslim leaders are at the centre of any such discussion and guide that discussion in a way that Australian Muslims as a whole do not feel targeted. Because there is a real risk when you have a discussion about extremist Islam, you have a real risk that Muslims as a whole feel under pressure. Equally, if you don’t have that discussion, you play into the hands of extremists at the other end of the spectrum. Continue reading...
body.zh: 关注当天的新闻直播 获取我们新的政治电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 威尔逊表示，体育区拨款报告揭示了一种“行为模式”。蒂姆·威尔逊表示，工党有很多问题需要回答美国广播公司的一份报告，该报告称，卫生部长马克·巴特勒的办公室要求阿德莱德议会在任何详细成本核算或正式规划完成之前，提出一项 600 万美元的体育区升级计划，以获得联邦资助。我认为我们现在看到的是一种行为模式。总理向他家附近的选区的一个高尔夫球场拨款，他是该高尔夫球场的会员，但他没有申报。现在我们的卫生部长、下一任想成为总理的人也在做同样的事情。我认为我们面临的问题是政府在上次选举前拼命试图留任。现在，选举的结果与 2024 年 11 月时的情况有所不同。因此，他们急忙尝试发放公共资金，以使自己处于有利的位置。问题是它现在正在追赶他们。这是一件很难做到的事情。然而，我认为做到这一点的一种方法是确保穆斯林领导人处于任何此类讨论的中心，并以澳大利亚穆斯林作为一个整体不会感到受到攻击的方式引导讨论。因为当你讨论伊斯兰极端主义时，确实存在风险，整个穆斯林都面临着压力。同样，如果你不进行这样的讨论，你就会落入另一端极端分子的手中。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Allegations of a 'pattern of behaviour' in Australian politics, suggesting potential misuse of public funds, raise questions about accountability and ethical leadership. Micah 6:8 calls us to 'act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God,' reminding leaders and citizens alike of the importance of integrity and fairness in public life.
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚政坛所谓的“行为模式”指控，暗示了公共资金可能被滥用，这引发了对领导层问责制和道德操守的质疑。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们“行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心与你的雅伟同行”，提醒领导者和所有公民在公共生活中诚信和公平的重要性。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Six green card holders in Texas charged in federal crackdown on illegal voting – as it happened
title.zh: 特朗普抨击阻止邮寄投票行政命令的决定：“这个法院真的让我们的国家失望了”——直播

summary.en: The president called mail-in voting – which he has used on several occasions to cast a ballot – ‘a laughing stock’ across the world. The Supreme Court has rejected Trump’s mail ballot restrictions for midterm elections. Kash Patel, the FBI director, is now testifying before lawmakers on the Senate judiciary committee.
summary.zh: 总统称邮寄投票——他本人曾多次使用邮寄投票——是全世界的“笑柄”。最高法院驳回了特朗普对中期选举的邮寄选票限制。联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔目前正在参议院司法委员会就此向议员们作证。

body.en: This live blog is now closed. Sign up for US Breaking News emails Kash Patel , the FBI director, is now testifying before lawmakers on the Senate judiciary committee. A reminder that the last time he appeared before Congress was in May, when he sparred with senators on the appropriations committee and denied – under oath – allegations of excessive drinking and unexplained absences on the job, dismissing them as “baseless” during a fiery congressional hearing. Today’s hearing is also expected to be full of heated exchanges. “Mr Patel is the least qualified and most partisan FBI director in our nation’s history,” said Senator Dick Durbin, the judiciary committee’s top Democrat. “The bureau has been reshaped as a political weapon against President Trump’s political enemies and a shield to protect the president and his MAGA loyalists, not the American people.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 总统称邮寄投票——他曾多次使用这种方式进行投票——在全世界都是“笑柄”。最高法院驳回了特朗普对中期选举的邮寄选票限制。联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔目前正在参议院司法委员会的议员面前作证。提醒人们，他最后一次出现在国会是在五月份，当时他与拨款委员会的参议员发生争执，并在宣誓后否认了有关过度饮酒和不明原因缺勤的指控，并在一场激烈的国会听证会上驳斥称这些指控“毫无根据”。今天的听证会预计也会充满激烈的交流。 “帕特尔先生是我们国家历史上最不合格、最具党派倾向的联邦调查局局长，”司法委员会民主党领袖、参议员迪克·杜宾(Dick Durbin)说。 “该局已被重塑为对抗特朗普总统政敌的政治武器，以及保护总统和他的 MAGA 忠诚者而不是美国人民的盾牌。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Supreme Court's rejection of mail-in voting restrictions, despite the president's strong objections, underscores the principle that legal processes often require hearing multiple perspectives. Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that even in disputes, there is value in listening to each party before rendering a verdict, a principle crucial for maintaining trust...
reflection.zh: 最高法院驳回了对邮寄投票的限制，尽管总统对此表示强烈反对，这凸显了法律程序通常需要听取多方观点的原则。箴言18:17提醒我们，即使在争端中，在做出裁决之前听取各方陈述也是有价值的，这一原则对于维护机构的信任至关重要。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: The Palestinian school under siege – podcast
title.zh: 巴勒斯坦一所受围困学校的播客

summary.en: At least five pupils at a village school in the West Bank have been killed in the last year by settlers and soldiers. Emma Graham-Harrison reports on how the school found itself on the frontline, while a teacher explains what life is like for staff and students.
summary.zh: 在过去一年里，至少有五名西岸村庄学校的学生被定居者和士兵杀害。艾玛·格雷厄姆-哈里森报道了学校如何发现自己身处前线，而一位老师则解释了教职员工和学生的生活状况。

body.en: At least five pupils at a village school in the West Bank have been killed in the last year by settlers and soldiers. Emma Graham-Harrison reports on how the school found itself on the frontline, while a teacher explains what life is like for staff and students. Waheed Abu Naim is an English teacher at the Al Mughayyir boys’ school in a village in the West Bank. He loves his job, he says. “I am happy to be a teacher. Although we don’t get lots of money, because my students, especially in the morning, wait for me when I enter the school to shake hands, to smile at me while going inside their classes. So it’s a happy life.” But the last year has been anything but happy for Waheed. His village is now surrounded by settlers, while the military has blocked off every road except one, which has a checkpoint on it. Teachers who live in neighbouring villages cannot always come to work. But worse are the attacks on the village by settlers. Continue reading...
body.zh: 去年，西岸一所乡村学校至少有五名学生被定居者和士兵杀害。艾玛·格雷厄姆·哈里森 (Emma Graham-Harrison) 报道了学校如何站在前线，而老师则解释了教职员工和学生的生活。瓦希德·阿布·纳伊姆 (Waheed Abu Naim) 是约旦河西岸一个村庄的 Al Mughayyir 男子学校的英语老师。他说，他热爱自己的工作。 “我很高兴成为一名老师。虽然我们没有很多钱，但因为我的学生，尤其是早上，当我进入学校时，他们会等我握手，走进教室时对我微笑。所以这是幸福的生活。”但去年对瓦希德来说一点也不开心。他的村庄现在被定居者包围，军队封锁了除一条道路外的所有道路，这条道路上设有检查站。住在邻村的老师不可能总是来上班。但更糟糕的是定居者对村庄的袭击。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The report from Al Mughayyir boys' school paints a stark picture of children caught in conflict, where even the pursuit of education is fraught with danger. Waheed Abu Naim's dedication to his students, finding joy in their smiles despite the surrounding violence, speaks to a profound commitment. This situation calls to mind the ancient wisdom to "speak up...
reflection.zh: 来自穆盖耶尔男子学校的报道描绘了一幅令人心酸的画面：孩子们被卷入冲突，即使是追求教育也充满危险。瓦希德·阿布·奈姆对他的学生们怀有深厚的承诺，尽管周围充满暴力，他却能在孩子们的笑容中找到快乐。这种情况让人想起古老的智慧：“你们要为不能说话的开口，为所有孤苦者伸冤”（箴言...

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Saudi Arabia warns of ‘red line’ after Houthi drone intercepted close to holy city of Mecca
title.zh: 沙特警告“红线”：胡塞无人机被拦截在圣城麦加附近

summary.en: Saudi Arabia's air defenses intercepted and destroyed a Houthi drone south of Mecca on Tuesday, preventing it from entering prohibited airspace over the holy city. A spokesperson for the Saudi-led military coalition stated that the security of Islam's two holiest sites and pilgrims is a 'red line,' and that deterrent...
summary.zh: 沙特阿拉伯的防空部队周二在麦加南部拦截并摧毁了一架胡塞无人机，阻止其进入圣城上空的禁飞区。领导军事联盟的发言人表示，伊斯兰教两圣地和朝圣者的安全是“红线”，并将对胡塞武装采取威慑措施。伊朗支持的武装组织否认其目标是麦加。

body.en: The Iran-aligned militant group rejected the suggestion it had targeted Mecca, while the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation condemned the attack Saudi Arabia’s air defences intercepted and destroyed a ⁠Houthi drone south of Mecca on Tuesday before it entered prohibited airspace over the holy city, according to a ⁠spokesperson for the ⁠Saudi-led ​military coalition which is fighting the Iran-aligned group in Yemen . The security of Islam’s two holiest sites and of pilgrims was a “red line”, ⁠coalition spokesperson Turki al-Malki said early on Wednesday, adding that the coalition would take necessary deterrent measures against the ⁠Houthis. Continue reading...
body.zh: 与伊朗结盟的武装组织拒绝了其以麦加为目标的说法，而伊斯兰合作组织则谴责沙特阿拉伯防空系统周二在麦加以南拦截并摧毁了一架胡塞无人机的袭击，该无人机进入圣城上空的禁空，据沙特领导的军事联盟发言人表示，该联盟正在也门与伊朗结盟的组织作战。伊斯兰两大圣地和朝圣者的安全是一条“红线”，联盟发言人图尔基·马尔基周三早些时候表示，并补充说联盟将对胡塞武装采取必要的威慑措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The interception of a drone near Mecca, a city of profound spiritual significance, raises tensions and the specter of further conflict. Saudi Arabia's declaration of a 'red line' and intent for 'deterrent measures' speaks to the understandable desire to protect sacred spaces. Yet, this response risks escalating the cycle of retaliation, mirroring the very...
reflection.zh: 一架无人机在具有深远精神意义的麦加城附近被拦截，加剧了紧张局势和进一步冲突的阴影。沙特阿拉伯宣布“红线”并打算采取“威慑措施”，体现了保护圣地的合理愿望。然而，这种回应有加剧报复循环的风险，可能与他们试图抵御的威胁如出一辙。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Human remains found in Arizona after deadly Grand Canyon flash floods
title.zh: 亚利桑那州大峡谷山洪暴发后发现人体残骸

summary.en: Human remains have been found near Crystal Rapids in Arizona, more than two weeks after a flash flood swept through the Grand Canyon, resulting in two deaths and one person still missing. National Park Service personnel recovered the remains and transferred them to the Coconino County Medical Examiner's office.
summary.zh: 在亚利桑那州水晶急流附近发现了人体残骸，此前两周大峡谷发生山洪暴发，造成两人死亡，一人失踪。国家公园管理局人员找到了这些遗骸，并将其移交给科科尼诺县验尸官办公室。

body.en: Hiker Timothy Smith, 53, missing after late-August floods but officials decline to identify remains Human remains have been discovered near Arizona’s Crystal Rapids, over two weeks after a flash flood tore through the Grand Canyon, leaving two people dead and one person missing. National Park Service personnel recovered the remains, before transferring them to the Coconino county medical examiner’s office, the agency confirmed over email. Continue reading...
body.zh: 53 岁的徒步旅行者蒂莫西·史密斯 (Timothy Smith) 在 8 月下旬的洪水后失踪，但官员拒绝确认遗骸身份 两周多前，一场山洪席卷了大峡谷，造成两人死亡、一人失踪，亚利桑那州水晶急流附近发现了人类遗骸。国家公园管理局通过电子邮件证实，工作人员找到了遗体，然后将其转移到科科尼诺县法医办公室。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The discovery of human remains in the Grand Canyon brings a somber end to the search for Timothy Smith, a hiker lost in the late August floods. This news evokes the deep sorrow that accompanies such loss, reminding us of the fragility of life. Yet, scripture offers a vision of ultimate comfort, where Yahweh promises a future where 'he will wipe away every...
reflection.zh: 在大峡谷发现人体残骸，为搜寻八月下旬洪水失踪的徒步旅行者蒂莫西·史密斯画上了悲伤的句号。这一消息令人深感悲痛，提醒我们生命的脆弱。然而，圣经提供了一个终极安慰的愿景，雅伟应许未来“神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭嚎、疼痛，因为以前的事都过去了。”

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: All support acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour quit after Macklemore dropped
title.zh: 埃德·希兰美国巡演所有助演嘉宾退出，此前麦克尔莫尔被取消资格

summary.en: All remaining support acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour have withdrawn following rapper Macklemore's removal from the lineup due to pro-Palestinian statements made on stage. Artists like Finneas cited the need to speak up for the oppressed, with others also announcing their departure.
summary.zh: 埃德·希兰美国巡演中所有剩余的助演嘉宾已退出，此前说唱歌手麦克尔莫尔因在舞台上发表亲巴勒斯坦言论而被取消资格。包括菲尼亚斯在内的艺术家们表示，必须为受压迫者发声，其他艺人也宣布退出。

body.en:
All of the remaining support acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour have quit, after the rapper Macklemore was dropped from the line-up for making pro-Palestinian remarks on stage.

Among them were Finneas, the brother of pop star Billie Eilish, who said in a statement: "Artists must not be silenced when they speak up for the oppressed."

Irish singer-songwriter Aaron Rowe and Danish band Lukas Graham also announced their departure. Irish folk band Beoga, who perform with Sheeran on stage every night, dropped out too.

The announcements came hours after Sheeran said he would not be drawn into a public debate over Gaza, and stressed he was not responsible for Macklemore being removed from the tour.

"Macklemore coming off tour was the promoter's decision, it was not mine," Sheeran said on Instagram.

"I would never let down the fans who had made plans, nor would I abandon the touring crew and the other support acts and musicians who rely on me for work and to make a living."

Earlier this month, Macklemore - real name Benjamin Haggerty - called for a "free Palestine" and showed images of devastation in Gaza during two concerts in New Jersey.

His comments drew criticism from Jewish groups, after which some venues put pressure on the tour promoters to drop him from the tour.

In his statement , external , Sheeran said he had spoken with the venues "at length all week to try and build a bridge" - but the promoters, Messina Touring Group, had ultimately pulled the plug.

While the star said he was “appalled by the conflict between Israel and Palestine" and that the "suffering and pain caused on both sides is a human tragedy", he also attempted to explain his decision to keep political issues at arm’s length.

"I am not complicit," he wrote. "I have my personal views on this devastating conflict. Just because I choose not to speak publicly, it doesn't mean I don't have them, and it doesn't mean I don't care.

He continued: "There is a reason I do not use my professional platform for politics - my audience includes young people, often children, of all backgrounds.

"Those who come to my shows do not expect a political forum. I respect Macklemore's strength of purpose to stand up and shout for what he believes.

"I choose to use my fame and platform to be a place of safety and sanctuary, to maintain diplomacy and keep conversations open, not closed. If we only focus on shouting the loudest, nothing will ever change. There are different approaches to being an advocate for change."

Sheeran added that, “as with all my support acts", Macklemore had been allowed to choose his own setlist.

If the statement was meant to placate his fans and other artists on the line-up, it has seemingly had the opposite effect.

body.zh: 在说唱歌手麦克勒莫尔因在舞台上发表亲巴勒斯坦言论而被除名后，艾德·希兰美国巡演的所有剩余支持活动都已退出。 其中包括流行歌星比莉·艾利什的兄弟芬尼斯，他在一份声明中表示：“当艺术家为受压迫者发声时，他们绝不能被压制。” 爱尔兰创作歌手亚伦·罗和丹麦乐队卢卡斯·格雷厄姆也宣布离开。每晚与希兰一起在舞台上表演的爱尔兰民谣乐队 Beoga 也退出了。 在宣布这一消息的几个小时前，希兰表示他不会卷入有关加沙问题的公开辩论，并强调他对麦克莫尔被排除在巡回演出之外不承担任何责任。 希兰在 Instagram 上表示：“麦克莫尔退出巡演是主办方的决定，不是我的决定。” “我永远不会让已经制定计划的歌迷失望，我也不会放弃巡演团队和其他支持我的艺人和音乐家，他们依靠我工作和谋生。” 本月早些时候，麦克莫尔（真名本杰明·哈格蒂）呼吁建立一个“自由的巴勒斯坦”，并在新泽西州的两场音乐会上展示了加沙遭受破坏的图像。 他的言论引起了犹太团体的批评，之后一些场馆向巡演发起人施压，要求他退出巡演。 希兰在对外声明中表示，他“整个星期都与场馆进行了长时间的交谈，试图建造一座桥梁”，但主办方墨西拿旅游集团最终取消了这一计划。 虽然这位明星表示，他“对以色列和巴勒斯坦之间的冲突感到震惊”，并且“双方造成的苦难和痛苦是一场人类悲剧”，但他也试图解释自己与政治问题保持距离的决定。 “我不是同谋，”他写道。 “我对这场毁灭性的冲突有我个人的看法。仅仅因为我选择不公开发言，并不意味着我没有这些看法，也不意味着我不在乎。 他继续说道：“我不利用我的专业平台参与政治是有原因的——我的受众包括各种背景的年轻人，通常是儿童。 “那些来观看我的演出的人并不期望看到一个政治论坛。我尊重麦克莫尔站起来并为他的信念大声疾呼的坚定决心。 “我选择利用我的名誉和平台成为一个安全和避难所，维持外交并保持对话开放，而不是封闭。如果我们只专注于大声喊叫，什么都不会改变。倡导变革有不同的方法。” 希兰补充说，“就像我所有的支持行为一样”，麦克莫尔被允许选择自己的演出名单。 如果该声明的目的是安抚他的粉丝和其他艺术家，那么它似乎产生了相反的效果。 卢卡斯·格雷厄姆在 Instagram 上写道：“我们应该能够……

reflection.en: When artists use their platform to speak for those without a voice, they echo a timeless call to defend the oppressed. The withdrawal of multiple acts from Ed Sheeran's tour, in solidarity with Macklemore's pro-Palestinian statements, highlights the courage it takes to stand with the marginalized, even at personal cost. This action reflects the biblical...
reflection.zh: 当艺术家利用他们的平台为无声者发声时，他们呼应了为受压迫者辩护的永恒呼召。多个助演团体退出埃德·希兰的巡演，声援麦克尔莫尔的亲巴勒斯坦言论，这凸显了即使付出个人代价也要与边缘化群体站在一起的勇气。这一行动反映了圣经中为弱势群体争取权益的命令。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Inquiry's new light on 'complete failure' around Lucy Letby murders: Here's what we know
title.zh: 关于露西·莱特比谋杀案的“完全失败”的调查新发现：我们所知道的

summary.en: A public inquiry in the United Kingdom concluded that hospital managers could have prevented nurse Lucy Letby from killing more babies if they had taken action against her sooner. Letby is serving a life sentence for murdering seven newborns and attempting to murder eight more between 2015 and 2016. She maintains her...
summary.zh: 英国一项公开调查得出结论，如果医院管理人员早些对护士露西·莱特比采取行动，本可以阻止她杀死更多婴儿。莱特比因在2015年至2016年间谋杀七名新生儿并企图谋杀另外八名而被判处无期徒刑。她坚称自己无罪，并有一个宣传活动认为她遭受了司法不公。

body.en:
A public inquiry in the United Kingdom concluded on Tuesday that hospital managers could have prevented nurse Lucy Letby from killing more babies in her care had they taken action against her sooner.

Letby is serving life in jail after being found guilty of murdering seven newborns and attempting to murder eight more between June 2015 and June 2016 while working at the Countess of Chester Hospital in northern England.

She has always maintained her innocence, and in recent years there has been a growing campaign arguing she was a victim of a miscarriage of justice.

Here are details about her, the controversy around her convictions and the public inquiry.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Letby, 36, was born in Hereford in central England. She completed a nursing degree at Chester University in north-west England, and after qualifying, she began working in the neonatal unit of the city's Countess of Chester Hospital.

Over 18 months from January 2015, there was a significant rise in the number of babies dying and suffering serious collapses at the neonatal unit.

Senior doctors became worried as many of the babies had deteriorated suddenly and unexpectedly, and then did not respond to appropriate resuscitation.

Other babies, who suddenly collapsed and did not die, recovered, with both their collapse and recovery defying usual medical norms.

The police and medical experts were called in and, as they looked for a cause, they eventually focused on one common factor: Lucy Letby.

She was first arrested in July 2018, again in June 2019 and a third time in November 2020, when she was charged with murdering seven babies and attempting to kill another 10 between June 2015 and July 2016.

Prosecutors said Letby attacked 17 babies who had been on the ward. Some she was said to have poisoned with insulin. Mostly she was accused of injecting air into their bloodstream or stomachs, or giving them excessive milk.

The victims included twins and triplets, and in one case, she killed two siblings on consecutive days. The youngest baby she murdered was just a day old. The oldest was 11 weeks old, a baby girl whom she attacked four times before she died.

Although the babies had been born prematurely, some were regarded as being in reasonable or good condition before they suddenly deteriorated, mainly during night shifts when Letby was working.

Letby attacked a number of the babies shortly after their parents had left their bedside, prosecutors said.

Police said she had kept medical records at her home with reference to some of the babies involved and had also carried out social media searches for their parents and families.

She denied any wrongdoing and...
body.zh: 英国的一项公开调查周二得出结论，如果医院管理人员早点对护士露西·莱比采取行动，他们本可以阻止她杀害更多她照顾的婴儿。 莱比在英格兰北部切斯特伯爵夫人医院工作期间，于 2015 年 6 月至 2016 年 6 月期间谋杀了 7 名新生儿，并试图谋杀另外 8 名新生儿，被判终身监禁，目前正在监狱服刑。 她一直坚称自己是清白的，近年来，越来越多的运动认为她是误判的受害者。 以下是有关她的详细信息、围绕她的定罪的争议以及公众调查。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 36 岁的莱特比出生于英格兰中部赫里福德。她在英格兰西北部的切斯特大学完成了护理学位，取得资格后，她开始在该市切斯特伯爵夫人医院的新生儿科工作。 自 2015 年 1 月起的 18 个月内，新生儿病房死亡和严重虚脱的婴儿数量显着增加。 高级医生开始担心，因为许多婴儿的病情突然出人意料地恶化，然后对适当的复苏没有反应。 其他突然倒下但没有死亡的婴儿却康复了，他们的倒下和恢复都违背了通常的医学规范。 警察和医学专家被请来，在寻找原因时，他们最终集中在一个共同因素上：露西·莱比。 她于 2018 年 7 月首次被捕，2019 年 6 月再次被捕，2020 年 11 月第三次被捕，当时她被指控在 2015 年 6 月至 2016 年 7 月期间谋杀 7 名婴儿并试图杀害另外 10 名婴儿。 检察官称，莱比袭击了病房里的 17 名婴儿。据说有些人是她用胰岛素中毒的。大多数情况下，她被指控向他们的血液或胃中注入空气，或者给他们过量的牛奶。 受害者包括双胞胎和三胞胎，在一个案件中，她连续几天杀死了两个兄弟姐妹。她谋杀的最小的婴儿才出生一天。最大的一个是11周大的女婴，她在死前曾袭击过四次。 尽管这些婴儿是早产儿，但有些婴儿在突然恶化之前被认为状况良好或良好，主要是在莱比工作的夜班期间。 检察官称，在父母离开床边后不久，莱比就袭击了一些婴儿。 警方表示，她在家中保存了一些涉案婴儿的医疗记录，并在社交媒体上搜索了他们的父母和家人。 她否认有任何不当行为，并且...

reflection.en: The inquiry's findings point to a tragic failure of oversight, where inaction by hospital managers allowed a predator to continue harming innocent children. This underscores the profound responsibility of those in positions of authority to act decisively to protect the vulnerable, as mandated by Yahweh's call for justice and righteousness.
reflection.zh: 调查结果揭示了监管上的悲剧性失误，医院管理人员的不作为让一名施害者得以继续伤害无辜的儿童。这凸显了掌权者保护弱势群体的重大责任，正如雅伟呼吁公正和公义所要求的。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Trump blasts 'horrible' Supreme Court decision after it blocks plan to restrict mail-in ballots
title.zh: 特朗普抨击最高法院阻止其限制邮寄选票的计划

summary.en: US President Donald Trump has sharply criticized the Supreme Court after it blocked his executive order aimed at restricting mail-in ballots. Democrats lauded the decision, calling the order "flagrantly unconstitutional." Trump expressed disappointment, suggesting the justices he appointed were not acting as he...
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在最高法院阻止其限制邮寄选票的行政命令后，严厉批评了最高法院。民主党人称赞该裁决，称该命令“明显违宪”。特朗普对结果表示失望，并暗示他任命的法官并未如他所愿行事。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump strongly criticised the nation's Supreme Court on Tuesday after it blocked his plan to restrict mail-in ballots, launching a rare and blistering attack on the justices he hand-picked in his first term.

Trump accused the court of allowing itself to be cowed by Democrats following the ruling, which comes as a blow to Republican hopes of keeping control of Congress in November's midterm elections.

"These are not the people I interviewed to serve on the United States Supreme Court, they are merely a shell of their original selves," Trump said on his Truth Social network.

Trump appointed three Supreme Court justices in his first term — Amy Coney Barrett, Brett Kavanaugh and Neil Gorsuch — giving the court a conservative supermajority.

But in his lengthy social media diatribe, the 80-year-old Republican now blamed them for some of the most "destructive, hurtful, and damaging decisions in our Country's history".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"The Supreme Court has really let our Country down! Certain Justices are petrified of these crazed and depraved Democrats, and are totally unable to show the courage necessary to save our America," he said.

US attorney-general Todd Blanche — who was formerly Trump's personal lawyer during a string of civil and criminal cases — defended the president's attack on the judiciary.

"He is very frustrated," Blanche told reporters at a press conference in the White House Rose Garden. "He has every right, and indeed he should communicate his concerns with the Supreme Court whenever he has them."

Blanche added that the Trump administration could continue to pursue mail-in voting changes despite the court ruling.

Trump signed an executive order in March requiring the compilation of lists of eligible voters and requiring the US Postal Service to deliver ballots only to voters who are on the lists.

He says without evidence that mail-in ballots are vulnerable to fraud, falsely blaming them for his 2020 election loss to Joe Biden.

But his plan faced multiple challenges and the Supreme Court on Monday denied Trump's request to lift an order halting it.

Kavanaugh, in a concurring opinion with the majority, said Trump's plan may ultimately be legal in the long run, but "state and local election officials do not have sufficient time to reasonably implement the rule before the elections".

Only two of the six conservative justices on the nine-member panel offered a dissent.

"It is not easy for me to write this criticism of the United States Supreme Court — it will likely cost me dearly for years to come — but I feel it my obligation and duty,...
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周二强烈批评美国最高法院，因为最高法院阻止了他限制邮寄选票的计划，对他在第一个任期内亲自挑选的法官发起了罕见的猛烈攻击。 特朗普指责法院在裁决后让自己被民主党吓倒，这对共和党在 11 月中期选举中保持对国会控制权的希望是一个打击。 特朗普在他的真相社交网络上说：“这些人不是我采访的在美国最高法院任职的人，他们只是原始自我的外壳。” 特朗普在第一个任期内任命了三名最高法院法官——艾米·科尼·巴雷特、布雷特·卡瓦诺和尼尔·戈萨奇——让保守派在最高法院占据绝对多数。 但这位 80 岁的共和党人在他冗长的社交媒体谩骂中指责他们做出了一些“我们国家历史上最具破坏性、伤害性和破坏性的决定”。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “最高法院真的让我们的国家失望了！某些法官被这些疯狂和堕落的民主党人吓呆了，完全无法表现出拯救我们美国所需的勇气，”他说。 美国司法部长托德·布兰奇（Todd Blanche）曾在一系列民事和刑事案件中担任特朗普的私人律师，为总统对司法机构的攻击进行了辩护。 “他非常沮丧，”布兰奇在白宫玫瑰园举行的新闻发布会上告诉记者。 “他有一切权利，事实上，只要他有疑问，他就应该向最高法院表达他的担忧。” 布兰奇补充说，尽管法院做出了裁决，特朗普政府仍可能继续寻求邮寄投票的改变。 特朗普于三月份签署了一项行政命令，要求编制合格选民名单，并要求美国邮政服务仅向名单上的选民投递选票。 他表示，在没有证据的情况下，邮寄选票很容易受到欺诈，并错误地指责邮寄选票是他在 2020 年选举中输给乔·拜登的原因。 但他的计划面临多重挑战，最高法院周一驳回了特朗普取消停止该计划的命令的请求。 卡瓦诺与多数人意见一致，他表示，从长远来看，特朗普的计划最终可能是合法的，但“州和地方选举官员没有足够的时间在选举前合理执行该规则”。 在九名成员组成的小组中，六名保守派法官中只有两名提出异议。 “对我来说，写这篇对美国最高法院的批评并不容易——这可能会让我在未来几年付出高昂的代价——但我觉得这是我的义务和责任，……

reflection.en: When leaders clash with the judiciary, it can reveal a tension between political aims and the rule of law. Proverbs 16:12 reminds us that "Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people." True leadership is characterized by integrity and justice, even when decisions are unpopular or challenge personal agendas.
reflection.zh: 当领导人与司法部门发生冲突时，可能会暴露出政治目标与法治之间的紧张关系。《箴言》16:12 提醒我们：“王凭公义治国，能以公义治国，但凭公义治国，能以公义治国。”真正的领导力是以正直和公正为特征的，即使在决定不受欢迎或挑战个人议程时也是如此。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: Five takeaways from Canada's push to woo the world's richest investors
title.zh: 卡尼称加拿大是全球金融的“安全港”

summary.en: Prime Minister Mark Carney is hosting a major global investment summit, with the goal of attracting money into the country amid a trade war with the US. Carney has pledged to bring in C$1tn in investments in the next five years as he seeks to reduce Canada's reliance on the US.
summary.zh: 在与美国的贸易战背景下，总理正在主办一次重要的全球投资峰会，目标是吸引资金进入加拿大。卡尼承诺在未来五年内吸引一万亿加元（约合86万亿美元）的投资，以减少加拿大对美国的依赖。

body.en:
Prime Minister Mark Carney is pitching Canada as a "safe harbour" for some of the world's largest investors in an era of geopolitical and economic uncertainty.

Canada is "perfectly situated to build in the new global economic order", he told more than 100 major investors in Toronto.

The prime minister has pledged to bring in C$1tn ($720bn; £530bn) in investments in the ‌next ⁠five years as he seeks to reduce Canada's reliance on the US, and the summit he convened this week is a test of whether he can deliver on promises to strengthen economic resilience.

The stakes are high as the trade dispute with the US has pushed Canada to seek deeper economic partnerships with Europe, Asia and the Middle East.

Carney said over the weekend that the summit was chance for the deep-pocketed financiers attending, representing more than C$120tn of assets, to "come to 'peer into our shop window'".

More than 160 projects were on offer, from data centres to pipelines and port expansions.

Ottawa also dangled a series of new tax incentives, including a "mega deduction" measure in front of potential buyers, and the prime minister underscored government efforts to offer faster approvals for big projects.

Economic analysts have said Canada needs to make significant policy changes to help attract investment, including more competitive tax and regulatory systems, and ensuring a supply of skilled labour.

Carney said Ottawa will now offer "predictability" for major proposed projects, with the goals of a one-year review timeline.

On Monday, he held bilateral ‌meetings with chief executives from major finance companies, like BlackRock's Larry Fink and Blackstone president Jon Gray.

One of the big announcements to come out of the summit was Carney's plan to allow private investment in four of Canada's main airports, in Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal and Calgary.

The prime minister said the plan would raise billions of dollars that could be reinvested in transport infrastructure, including smaller regional airports.

Many developed countries allow some degree of private investment in airports, but Canada has lagged behind and its airports operate through a not-for-profit governance model.

Under Carney's new proposal, the federal government will retain ownership of the underlying land and assets, but allow private investments into airport operations.

Labour unions have criticised the proposal, saying it will be bad for both workers and passengers.

"In the middle of a trade war, handing profitable public infrastructure over to private investors is exactly the wrong move," said Lily Chang, with the Canadian Labour Congress, in a statement.

But Nick Barry-Shaw, of the advocacy group Council of Canadians, said it was "a privatisation summit".

body.zh: 在地缘政治和经济不确定的时代，加拿大总理马克·卡尼将加拿大视为世界上一些最大投资者的“安全港”。 周二，他对渥太华吸引的 100 多名主要投资者表示，加拿大“完全有能力构建新的全球经济秩序”。 卡尼承诺在未来五年内引入 1 万亿加元的投资，以减少加拿大对美国的依赖，本周的峰会将考验他能否兑现增强经济弹性的承诺。 他的目标是让该集团资产超过 120 万亿加元（86 万亿美元；64 万亿英镑），投资于国防、能源、采矿、人工智能和基础设施等领域。 随着与美国的关税战愈演愈烈，加拿大正在寻求与欧洲、亚洲和中东建立更深入的经济伙伴关系，卡尼一直致力于提升其全球形象。 许多参加多伦多活动的商界领袖都收到了总理的个人邀请，总理曾在全球金融高层工作，在从政之前曾担任央行行长。 卡尼周二上午表示：“我们的目标很简单：让加拿大成为七国集团中最具吸引力的投资地。” 作为这一举措的一部分，卡尼宣布了将该国四个最大机场的运营私有化的计划，并表示将筹集数十亿美元用于交通基础设施的再投资。 许多发达国家允许一定程度的私人投资机场，但加拿大却落后了，其机场在非营利治理模式下运营。 卡尼表示，联邦政府将保留基础土地和资产的所有权，但允许私人投资进入机场运营。 工会批评了这一提议，称这对工人和乘客都不利。 大部分活动将在当天的私人会议和双边会议中进行。 不过，将会有一些小组发言，其中包括德意志银行首席执行官 Christian Sewing、庞巴迪高管埃里克·马特尔、贝莱德首席执行官拉里·芬克和黑石总裁乔恩·格雷。 总理办公室淡化了峰会发布任何重大消息的可能性，卡尼周末表示，这是财力雄厚的金融家“来‘窥视我们商店橱窗’的机会”。 此次活动也是加拿大在经历了多年投资业绩滞后和重大项目审批缓慢的声誉后，提升其作为经商好地方的声誉的机会。 经济分析师表示，加拿大需要做出重大政策改变以帮助吸引投资，包括更具竞争力的税收和监管体系，并确保熟练劳动力的供应。 渥太华之间的贸易谈判...

reflection.en: In an era of global economic and geopolitical uncertainty, Prime Minister Mark Carney is positioning Canada as a "safe harbour" for investors. His ambitious goal of attracting C$1 trillion in investments over five years reflects a strategic effort to build economic resilience. This endeavor, like all significant undertakings, can be viewed through the lens...
reflection.zh: 在一个全球经济和地缘政治不确定的时代，总理马克·卡尼正将加拿大定位为投资者的“安全港”。他雄心勃勃地计划在五年内吸引一万亿加元的投资，以增强加拿大的经济韧性。这项事业，如同所有重大的事业一样，可以从箴言16:3的原则来看：“你要将你的事交托雅伟，你所谋定的就必坚固。”追求经济稳定和增长，当以勤奋和健全的原则为基础时，就与将结果托付给更高的目的相一致。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Four more acts quit Ed Sheeran tour as singer says Macklemore decision 'was not mine'
title.zh: 四组艺人退出艾德·希兰巡演，歌手称麦克尔莫尔的决定“非我所愿”

summary.en: Several acts have now followed the US rapper out the door after his onstage comments led to him being dropped from Sheeran's tour.
summary.zh: 在美国说唱歌手麦克尔莫尔因在舞台上的言论被取消巡演资格后，又有几组艺人跟随他退出了演出。

body.en:
Four supporting acts have quit Ed Sheeran's tour after the rapper Macklemore was removed for pro-Palestinian comments he made during a concert in New Jersey.

Hours after Sheeran posted on social media about Macklemore's removal and attributed the decision to the tour's promoters, Irish acts Aaron Rowe and Beoga, the Danish band Lukas Graham, and Finneas posted on Instagram that they would withdraw from Sheeran's tour.

Rowe was one of Macklemore's replacements for Sheeran's remaining US dates, while Beoga was serving as Sheeran's touring band. Finneas, who is Billie Eilish's brother and musical collaborator, was due to tour with Sheeran in South America later this year.

Rowe and Beoga each cited their country's history in their statements explaining their decision.

"We are Irish people who understand colonialism. As founding members of the Irish Artists for Palestine movement, we are committed activists for justice and will continue to be," Beoga said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"But as Irish people we know all too well about genocide, forced famine and violent occupation," he said, saying he could not "stand by and allow billionaires to use their position of power to silence the rightful voices of those who speak up".

Finneas, who has publicly advocated for Palestinians in the past, reiterated his support.

Lukas Graham, meanwhile, expressed gratitude toward Sheeran and called it "a difficult decision".

"Money doesn't give you the right to own the conversation. Nobody's bank balance should decide who gets to speak or which suffering we're allowed to acknowledge," the band posted, seemingly referring to billionaire Robert Kraft's role in Macklemore's removal from the tour.

Sheeran weighed in on Macklemore being dropped as his opening act after the rapper made pro-Palestinian comments onstage during their tour, saying the decision was made by the promoters alone. The British singer also said he refused to be drawn into a public discussion about the war in Gaza.

"Macklemore coming off tour was the promoter's decision, it was not mine," Sheeran wrote on Instagram on Tuesday. "I would never let down the fans who had made plans, nor would I abandon the touring crew and the other support acts and musicians who rely on me for work and to make a living."

Sheeran's statement came a day after Macklemore said he was kicked off the Loop Tour after exclaiming "Free Palestine!" during the 5 September date at New Jersey's MetLife Stadium while introducing his protest song Hind's Hall.

body.zh: 说唱歌手麦克勒莫尔因在新泽西州一场音乐会上发表亲巴勒斯坦言论而被除名后，四位配角退出了艾德·希兰的巡演。 希兰在社交媒体上发布有关麦克莫尔被驱逐的消息，并将这一决定归咎于巡演发起人，几小时后，爱尔兰艺人亚伦·罗和贝奥加、丹麦乐队卢卡斯·格雷厄姆和芬尼斯在 Instagram 上发帖表示，他们将退出希兰的巡演。 Rowe 是 Macklemore 的替代者之一，取代了 Sheeran 在美国的剩余演出，而 Beoga 则担任 Sheeran 的巡演乐队。芬尼斯是比莉·艾利什的兄弟和音乐合作者，他原定于今年晚些时候与希兰一起在南美巡演。 罗和贝奥加在解释其决定的声明中均引用了各自国家的历史。 “我们是了解殖民主义的爱尔兰人。作为爱尔兰艺术家支持巴勒斯坦运动的创始成员，我们是正义的积极分子，并将继续如此，”贝奥加说。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “但作为爱尔兰人，我们对种族灭绝、强迫饥荒和暴力占领太了解了，”他说，他不能“袖手旁观，允许亿万富翁利用他们的权力地位压制那些敢于发声的人的正当声音”。 过去曾公开支持巴勒斯坦人的芬尼斯重申了他的支持。 与此同时，卢卡斯·格雷厄姆对希兰表示感谢，并称这是“一个艰难的决定”。 乐队发帖称，“金钱并不赋予你掌控对话的权利。任何人的银行余额都不应决定谁能发言或我们可以承认哪些痛苦。”这似乎指的是亿万富翁罗伯特·克拉夫特在麦克勒莫被驱逐出巡演中所扮演的角色。 说唱歌手在巡演期间在舞台上发表了支持巴勒斯坦的言论后，希兰对麦克莫尔被取消开场表演的问题发表了看法，称这一决定是由主办方单独做出的。这位英国歌手还表示，他拒绝卷入有关加沙战争的公开讨论。 “麦克莫尔退出巡演是主办方的决定，不是我的决定，”希兰周二在 Instagram 上写道。 “我永远不会让已经制定计划的歌迷失望，我也不会放弃巡演团队和其他支持我的艺人和音乐家，他们依靠我工作和谋生。” 希兰发表声明的前一天，麦克莫尔表示，他因高喊“自由巴勒斯坦！”而被踢出环巡赛。 9 月 5 日在新泽西州大都会人寿体育场举行的约会期间，他介绍了他的抗议歌曲 Hind's Hall。 “对我所有的犹太兄弟姐妹来说，对以色列的批评、对种族隔离的批评、反对种族灭绝，这绝不是对你们的批评，”他在...

reflection.en: James 3:5 speaks of the tongue as a small part of the body that can set a whole forest ablaze. Macklemore's pro-Palestinian comments, though perhaps intended to spark dialogue, led to his removal from Ed Sheeran's tour. This, in turn, caused four other acts to withdraw, demonstrating how a single utterance can have far-reaching and unintended consequences,...
reflection.zh: 雅各书3:5说，舌头虽是身体最小的部分，却能点燃整片森林。麦克尔莫尔关于巴勒斯坦的言论，或许意在引发对话，却导致他被从艾德·希兰的巡演中除名。这进而引发了另外四组艺人的退出，表明一个单独的言论可能产生深远且意想不到的后果，在巡演的生态系统中点燃了一场更大的争议。

verse.textEn: The tongue is a small part of the body, but it makes great boasts. Consider what a great forest is set on fire by a small spark.
verse.textZh: 舌头在百体里也是最小的，却能说大话。看哪，最小的火能点着最大的树林。

title.en: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
title.zh: 伊朗战争导致美国弹药短缺，五角大楼检查长证实

summary.en: The inspector general of the US Department of Defense has confirmed 'shortfalls' in munitions and a bottleneck in resupply due to the war with Iran. This contradicts President Donald Trump's claims that US supplies are 'virtually limitless,' as the report indicates over $22 billion was spent on munitions between...
summary.zh: 美国国防部监察长证实，由于与伊朗的战争，弹药出现“短缺”且补给出现瓶颈。这与特朗普总统声称美国供应“几乎无限”的说法相矛盾，报告显示，从2月到6月，弹药支出超过220亿美元，导致“战略库存短缺”。

body.en:
The US defence department's inspector general says the war with Iran has led to "shortfalls" in munitions and a bottleneck in resupply, contradicting President Donald Trump who has repeatedly denied the US is facing shortages.

Trump has claimed US munitions supplies are "virtually unlimited" and said reporting otherwise is "fake news".

But the independent watchdog said the US spent more than $22 billion on munitions from February through June, leading to "strategic inventory shortfalls".

When asked about the watchdog's report, the White House said the US had "more than enough" munitions.

The report provides a first-of-its-kind, independent glimpse into US weapons stockpiles, data that is typically classified.

Over the course of the war, US forces have expended vast quantities of both long-range ground attack systems and the air and missile defences used to intercept incoming Iranian attacks.

A late July estimate from the Center for Strategic and International Studies, or CSIS, found that stocks of some interceptors - such as the Patriot missile and Terminal High Altitude Area Defense, or THAAD - were significantly depleted, in some cases by more than half.

The inspector general's report did not disclose exactly how many of the weapons remain.

It did, however, note the inventory shortfalls and reveal "industrial base bottlenecks" for munitions resupply.

The report added that the defence department is now working to "streamline procurement processes and production lead times" to address the shortages and "respond rapidly to a contingency".

"The United States military has more than enough munitions, ammo, and stockpiles to serve all of the Commander-in-Chief's strategic goals and beyond," spokeswoman Anna Kelly said in a statement on Tuesday.

Trump and other administration officials have also sought to cast reports of shortages as false and "treasonous" .

In a 4 August X post, Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth described news reporting on the shortages as "not true".

And in a lengthy Truth Social post on 3 September, Trump claimed that the US had "virtually unlimited" amounts of ammunition and is "stockpiling and preparing for any contingency that could happen".

The watchdog's report also notes that equipment losses have totalled $3.7bn, with other $7.4bn in other expenditures. Overall, the US spent $33.4bn (£24.7bn) on the war from 28 Feb to 30 Jun.

A separate estimate released on Tuesday by the Congressional Budget Office put the total cost of the war at higher at $38bn, which includes replaced expended munitions and equipment lost in battle, increased flying hours and greater fuel costs.

Among the losses have been four F-15e fighter jets, a highly advanced F-35 Joint Strike Fighter and 30 MQ-9 drones destroyed in "various...
body.zh: 美国国防部监察长表示，与伊朗的战争导致了弹药“短缺”和补给瓶颈，这与唐纳德·特朗普总统一再否认美国面临短缺的说法相矛盾。 特朗普声称美国的弹药供应“几乎是无限的”，并表示其他报道是“假新闻”。 但该独立监管机构表示，从 2 月到 6 月，美国在军火上的支出超过 220 亿美元，导致“战略库存短缺”。 这份新报告首次对美国武器库存进行了独立的了解，这些数据通常属于机密。 在战争过程中，美军消耗了大量的远程地面攻击系统以及用于拦截伊朗袭击的空中和导弹防御系统。 战略与国际研究中心（CSIS）7月底的一项估计发现，一些拦截弹的库存——例如爱国者导弹和末段高空区域防御系统（THAAD）——已严重耗尽，在某些情况下减少了一半以上。 监察长的报告没有透露到底还有多少武器。 然而，它确实注意到库存短缺，并揭示了弹药补给的“工业基地瓶颈”。 报告补充说，国防部目前正在努力“简化采购流程和生产周期”，以解决短缺问题并“迅速应对突发事件”。 特朗普和其他政府官员试图将短缺的报道定性为虚假和“叛国”。 例如，国防部长皮特·赫格斯 (Pete Hegseth) 在 8 月 4 日的帖子中称有关短缺的新闻报道“不真实”。 特朗普在 9 月 3 日发表的一篇长篇《真相社会》帖子中声称，美国拥有“几乎无限”数量的弹药，并且正在“储存并为任何可能发生的突发事件做好准备”。 该监管机构的报告还指出，设备损失总计 37 亿美元，其他支出为 74 亿美元。总体而言，2月28日至6月30日期间，美国在战争上花费了334亿美元（247亿英镑）。 国会预算办公室周二发布的另一项估计显示，战争总成本更高，达到 380 亿美元，其中包括更换消耗的弹药和在战斗中损失的设备、增加的飞行时间和更高的燃料成本。 损失包括四架 F-15e 战斗机、一架高度先进的 F-35 联合攻击战斗机和 30 架 MQ-9 无人机，这些无人机在“各种情况下”被摧毁。 当美国和以色列开始发动袭击时，特朗普多次表示冲突将在几周内结束。 最近，他表示冲突可能要到美国 11 月中期选举“之后”才会结束。 路透社/益普索 9 月初发布的一项民意调查发现，只有 23% 的人...

reflection.en: The prophet Isaiah envisioned a time when nations would 'beat their swords into plowshares' and 'learn war no more.' This report on US munitions shortfalls, driven by ongoing conflict, highlights the immense material cost of war and the persistent human struggle to move away from militarization. May we pray for wisdom and a global commitment to peace,...
reflection.zh: 先知以赛亚曾预言，列国将“把刀打成犁头”，并且“不再学习战事”。这份关于美国因持续冲突导致弹药短缺的报告，凸显了战争巨大的物质代价，以及人类在摆脱军事化道路上持续的挣扎。愿我们祈求智慧，并祈求全球致力于和平，将资源从毁灭转向维生之事。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Criticism of LGBTQ+ raids in Turkey is growing
title.zh: 土耳其对LGBTQ+的突袭引发日益增长的批评

summary.en: Several raids and arrests of LGBTQ+ persons in Turkey have triggered sharp criticism from numerous Turkish organizations and also from Brussels.
summary.zh: 土耳其对LGBTQ+人士的数次突袭和逮捕行动，已引发了土耳其国内众多组织以及来自布鲁塞尔的尖锐批评。

body.en:
Several raids and arrests of LGBTQ+ persons in Turkey have triggered sharp criticism from numerous Turkish organizations — and also from Brussels.

Raids targeting LGBTQ+ activists and organizations took place in Turkey over the weekend. Several people were arrested by the Turkish authorities and many social media accounts were blocked. The Turkish government's actions have drawn sharp criticism from across the country and also from Brussels .

Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan had announced the operation as part of the "Decade of Family and Population” scheme, a national strategy proclaimed in May 2025 that was to counter the drastic decline in the country's birthrate and strengthen the traditional, conservative family view in Turkey.

On Tuesday, Istanbul saw demonstrations again. Turkish LGBTQ+ associations emphasized in a joint declaration that it wasn't a crime to set up an association and advocate for rights.

"Freedom of assembly, freedom of opinion, protection of privacy and presumption of innocence apply to LGBTQ+ people as well," the declaration stated.

The LGBTQ+ community also received support from the women's movement. 120 women's rights organizations signed a joint declaration in which they criticized authoritarianism in Turkey.

"As women, we stand against the operations carried out in the name of 'keeping the family safe.' We know that the repression of our bodies, our lives, our identities, and our right to organize is part of the same authoritarian politics . Being [LGBTQ+] is not a crime! Organizing as [LGBTQ+] people is not a crime!", the organizations stated.

The government is trying to criminalize the LGBTQ+ community, says Yildiz Taghizade of Women for Women's Human Rights (WWHR), an organization that co-signed the declaration. This criminalization did not just start with the operations of the past few days, but had already been going on for a few years, according to Taghizade.

"The aim is not only to target LGBTQ+ people, but to practically ban the LGBTQ+ community from engaging in politics, getting organized, claiming rights and showing presence in the public sphere," Taghizade said.

It was no coincidence that the operation came with the slogan "My family is safe." 

"The government is trying to justify its actions by invoking the protection of families and children, but this narrative doesn't work. Because when we look at Turkey today and what is actually a factor of uncertainty for families, we come across very concrete issues such as poverty, the  housing crisis, unemployment, care work [caring for and tending to relatives, the ed.]  passed on to women, and male violence against women ," Taghizade said.

body.zh: 土耳其对 LGBTQ+ 人士的多次突袭和逮捕引发了众多土耳其组织以及布鲁塞尔的尖锐批评。 周末，土耳其发生了针对 LGBTQ+ 活动人士和组织的突袭行动。土耳其当局逮捕了数人，许多社交媒体账户被封锁。土耳其政府的行为引起了全国各地以及布鲁塞尔的尖锐批评。 土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安宣布这项手术是“家庭与人口十年”计划的一部分，该计划于 2025 年 5 月宣布，旨在应对该国出生率的急剧下降，并强化土耳其传统、保守的家庭观。 周二，伊斯坦布尔再次爆发示威活动。土耳其LGBTQ+协会在一份联合声明中强调，成立协会并倡导权利并不是犯罪。 声明指出：“集会自由、言论自由、隐私保护和无罪推定也适用于 LGBTQ+ 人群。” LGBTQ+ 群体也得到了妇女运动的支持。 120个妇女权利组织签署了一份联合声明，批评土耳其的独裁主义。 “作为女性，我们反对以‘保护家庭安全’的名义进行的手术。 我们知道，对我们的身体、我们的生活、我们的身份和我们的组织权利的镇压也是独裁政治的一部分。成为 [LGBTQ+] 并不是犯罪！ [LGBTQ+] 人士组织起来并不是犯罪！”这些组织表示。 共同签署该宣言的妇女促进妇女人权组织 (WWHR) 的 Yildiz Taghizade 表示，政府正试图将 LGBTQ+ 群体定为犯罪。塔吉扎德表示，这种刑事定罪不仅是从过去几天的行动开始的，而且已经持续了几年。 塔吉扎德说：“其目的不仅是针对 LGBTQ+ 人群，而且实际上是禁止 LGBTQ+ 群体参与政治、组织起来、主张权利以及在公共领域露面。” 这次行动的口号是“我的家人很安全”，这并非巧合。 塔吉扎德说：“政府试图通过保护家庭和儿童来证明其行动的合理性，但这种说法是行不通的。因为当我们审视今天的土耳其，以及实际上对家庭来说是一个不确定因素时，我们会遇到非常具体的问题，例如贫困、住房危机、失业、护理工作（照顾和照料亲戚，编辑）转嫁到女性身上，以及男性对女性的暴力，”塔吉扎德说。 其他组织也批评政府...

reflection.en: Raids and arrests targeting LGBTQ+ individuals in Turkey, as reported, raise concerns about the rights and safety of marginalized communities. The call for justice and protection for those who may be silenced or vulnerable echoes the ancient wisdom to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves." May we advocate for dignity and fairness for all,...
reflection.zh: 据报道，土耳其针对LGBTQ+人士的突袭和逮捕行动，引发了对边缘化社群权利和安全的担忧。为那些可能被噤声或弱势群体呼吁公正和保护的声音，呼应了古老的智慧：“为不能说话的人说话。” 愿我们都能为所有人的尊严和公平而倡导，尤其是在他们面对压迫之时。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Nigeria arrests alleged Mexican drug kingpin at international airport
title.zh: 尼日利亚在国际机场逮捕涉嫌墨西哥贩毒集团头目

summary.en: Nigerian authorities have announced the arrest of Arturo Carrera Loaiza, an alleged Mexican drug kingpin, at Lagos international airport last month. Loaiza denies involvement in methamphetamine production. The arrest led to the discovery of a suspected industrial-scale meth lab, the third linked to Mexicans in four...
summary.zh: 尼日利亚当局宣布，上个月在拉各斯国际机场逮捕了涉嫌墨西哥贩毒集团头目阿图罗·卡雷拉·洛艾萨。洛艾萨否认参与冰毒生产。此次逮捕导致发现了一个疑似工业规模的冰毒实验室，这是四个月内第三起据称与墨西哥人有关的发现。警方根据图像数据在埃博尼州找到了该实验室，图像显示洛艾萨身穿疑似实验室外套，并配有制毒设备。

body.en:
An alleged Mexican drug kingpin was arrested in Nigeria last month as he tried to leave the country, the drug enforcement authority has just revealed.

That arrest resulted in the discovery of a suspected industrial-scale methamphetamine laboratory - the third such find allegedly linked to Mexicans in four months.

When Arturo Carrera Loaiza, 40, was detained at Lagos international airport, officials allegedly found digital images of him wearing what they believed to be a laboratory coat alongside equipment consistent with meth production.

The pictures' location data led officers to a property in Ebonyi state, where they said chemicals and drug-making equipment were found.

Loaiza has denied involvement in methamphetamine production and said he had been invited to Nigeria by a local contact for a restaurant business venture, according to a statement from the National Drug Law Enforcement Agency (NDLEA).

The agency's investigators found a CCTV memory card at the suspected laboratory in Ebonyi with footage from the property showing someone who looked like Loaiza wearing a blue laboratory coat. A Nigerian man was also identified directing people as they removed chemicals and equipment from the site.

NDLEA chairman Gen Mohamed Buba Marwa said further intelligence led officers to an isolated house in a neighbouring community, where they recovered chemicals, dehydrators, condensers, a reaction pot, weighing scales, mixers, drums, gas burners and a sieve containing traces of methamphetamine.

No estimate has yet been given for how much methamphetamine the alleged laboratory was capable of producing.

Investigators have alleged that Loaiza had recruited and brought a fellow Mexican to work at another suspected methamphetamine laboratory hidden in a forest in Oyo state, which was raided in June. Four Nigerians were also arrested after the raid.

A month earlier, NDLEA officers arrested three Mexican nationals and seven Nigerians at what the agency described as an industrial-scale methamphetamine laboratory hidden in a forest in another part of the country.

Marwa said the operations showed international criminal groups were attempting to establish drug-production facilities in Nigeria's forests and rural communities.

"Nigeria will not be allowed to become a haven for transnational drug cartels seeking to relocate their laboratories from other jurisdictions into our forests and rural communities", he said.

The NDLEA said its investigation into the network is ongoing, including into those it believes financed or helped facilitate the operations in Nigeria.

Unlike plant-based drugs, such as cocaine or heroin, which can only be grown and processed in certain places, a synthetic drug like meth can be produced anywhere with the right chemicals and expertise,...
body.zh: 缉毒机构刚刚透露，一名被指控的墨西哥毒枭上个月在尼日利亚试图离开该国时被捕。 这次逮捕导致发现了一个疑似工业规模的甲基苯丙胺实验室——四个月内第三个此类发现据称与墨西哥人有关。 当 40 岁的阿图罗·卡雷拉·洛艾萨 (Arturo Carrera Loaiza) 在拉各斯国际机场被拘留时，官员据称发现了他身穿实验室外套的数码照片，旁边还有与冰毒生产相符的设备。 这些照片的位置数据引导警察找到了埃博尼州的一处房产，他们说在那里发现了化学品和制毒设备。 根据国家禁毒执法机构 (NDLEA) 的一份声明，洛艾萨否认参与甲基苯丙胺生产，并表示，当地一位联系人邀请他前往尼日利亚经营一家餐馆企业。 该机构的调查人员在埃博尼的可疑实验室发现了一张闭路电视存储卡，其中的录像显示一个看起来像洛艾萨的人穿着蓝色实验室外套。一名尼日利亚男子还被发现指挥人们从现场清除化学品和设备。 NDLEA 主席 Mohamed Buba Marwa 将军表示，进一步的情报引导警员来到邻近社区的一所偏僻的房子，在那里他们找到了化学品、脱水器、冷凝器、反应锅、秤、搅拌机、鼓、燃气燃烧器和含有微量甲基苯丙胺的筛子。 目前尚未估计该实验室能够生产多少甲基苯丙胺。 调查人员称，洛艾萨招募并带一名墨西哥同胞到奥约州森林中另一个疑似冰毒实验室工作，该实验室于 6 月遭到突袭。袭击后，四名尼日利亚人也被捕。 一个月前，NDLEA 官员在该国另一地区森林中的一个工业规模甲基苯丙胺实验室逮捕了三名墨西哥人和七名尼日利亚人。 马尔瓦表示，这些行动表明国际犯罪集团正试图在尼日利亚的森林和农村社区建立毒品生产设施。 他说：“尼日利亚不会被允许成为跨国贩毒集团寻求将其实验室从其他司法管辖区迁往我们的森林和农村社区的避风港。” NDLEA 表示，对该网络的调查正在进行中，包括对其认为资助或帮助促进尼日利亚运营的网络进行调查。 与可卡因或海洛因等植物性药物只能在某些地方种植和加工不同，像冰毒这样的合成药物可以在任何拥有适当化学品和专业知识的地方生产，...

reflection.en: The arrest of an alleged drug kingpin in Nigeria underscores the persistent global battle against illicit activities that harm communities. This situation calls for the pursuit of justice and accountability, reminding us of the prophet Micah's call to 'act justly and to love mercy.' May those working to dismantle such operations be guided by wisdom and...
reflection.zh: 在尼日利亚逮捕一名涉嫌贩毒的头目，凸显了全球打击危害社区的非法活动的持续斗争。这一情况呼唤对公正和怜悯的追求，提醒我们先知弥迦的呼吁：“只当公义行道，喜爱怜悯。”愿那些致力于瓦解此类犯罪活动的人，能被智慧和勇气所引导。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: South African president vows justice as more women's bodies found near Johannesburg
title.zh: 南非总统誓言伸张正义，因约翰内斯堡附近发现更多女性尸体

summary.en: Police have not linked the deaths to a serial killer but are investigating this possibility. South Africa's President Cyril Ramaphosa has vowed that "no stone will be left unturned" in finding those behind the killings of several women in and around Kempton Park, north-east of Johannesburg, over the last two months....
summary.zh: 警方尚未将这些死亡事件与连环杀手联系起来，但正在调查这种可能性。南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨誓言将“不遗余力”地寻找在过去两个月里在约翰内斯堡东北部的肯普顿帕克镇及其周边地区杀害数名女性的凶手。周二早上又发现一具尸体，警方正在调查是否有一群人是这些杀戮事件的幕后黑手。

body.en:
South Africa's President Cyril Ramaphosa has vowed that "no stone will be left unturned" in finding those behind the killings of several women in and around the town of Kempton Park, north-east of Johannesburg, over the last two months.

Another body was discovered on Tuesday morning and police say their investigation now includes the deaths of seven women most of whom have been found either partially or fully naked.

"These incidents are causing fear and uncertainty in our communities, and especially among women," the president said.

Police say they are not linking the deaths to a serial killer at this stage, but are investigating the possibility that a group of people is behind the killings.

"[It] could be that it's a copycat crime that is happening right here but so far, no linkages as yet," police spokesperson Brig Athlenda Mathe said.

One arrest has been made in connection with the discovery of the first body. The person is still in police custody.

On Monday, police said that one of them was Elizabeth Moselakgomo, a runner whose disappearance last week sparked a frantic and public search for her .

President Ramaphosa said he had directed that the cases be prioritised: "Our law enforcement agencies are working urgently to establish the facts, keep communities safe and bring the perpetrator or perpetrators to justice."

South Africa experiences some of the world's highest levels of gender-based violence (GBV), with the rate at which women are killed five times higher than the global average, according to UN Women.

The discoveries of the bodies have sparked outrage and fear across the country, with many criticising the authorities for failing to adequately protect women.

Moselakgomo was identified by her relatives on Monday after her body was discovered on Saturday. It was the 38-year-old's young daughter who raised the alarm about her disappearance after she failed to return from her daily run last Wednesday.

The body of the first woman was found in mid-July, the second in late August - the others were discovered this month, two in the last two days.

On Tuesday, police said that the body of woman found on 7 September in a town nearby Kempton Park was also being included - bringing the total number of bodies being investigated to seven.

"After noticing that there are bodies being picked up, we went back to our police stations… and unfortunately it came to light that a body of a female in her late 20s was observed in a river next to a mall," Maj-Gen Fred Kekana, acting police chief for Gauteng province, said at a briefing.

Police have urged women in the Kempton Park area - which is by South Africa's main international airport - to avoid walking or running alone "particularly in isolated areas".

South Africa's Commission for Gender...
body.zh: 南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨发誓，将“不遗余力”寻找过去两个月杀害约翰内斯堡东北部肯普顿帕克镇及周边地区数名妇女的幕后黑手。 周二上午发现了另一具尸体，警方表示，他们的调查目前包括七名女性的死亡，其中大多数被发现半裸或全身赤裸。 总统说：“这些事件给我们的社区，特别是女性带来了恐惧和不确定性。” 警方表示，现阶段他们并未将这些死亡事件与连环杀手联系起来，但正在调查是否有一群人是这起杀戮事件的幕后黑手。 警方发言人阿瑟伦达·马特准将表示：“这可能是一起正在发生的模仿犯罪，但到目前为止，还没有任何联系。” 因发现第一具尸体而逮捕了一名人员。该人仍被警方拘留。 周一，警方称其中一人是跑步运动员伊丽莎白·莫塞拉科莫(Elizabeth Moselakgomo)，她上周的失踪引发了公众对她的疯狂搜寻。 拉马福萨总统表示，他已指示优先处理这些案件：“我们的执法机构正在紧急努力查明事实，保障社区安全，并将肇事者绳之以法。” 据联合国妇女署称，南非是世界上性别暴力（GBV）最严重的国家之一，妇女被杀的比率是全球平均水平的五倍。 尸体的发现引发了全国各地的愤怒和恐惧，许多人批评当局未能充分保护妇女。 周六发现莫塞拉科莫的尸体后，周一她的亲属确认了她的身份。上周三，这位 38 岁的小女儿在每天跑步后未能返回后，对她的失踪发出了警报。 第一具女性尸体于 7 月中旬被发现，第二具女性尸体于 8 月下旬被发现，其他女性尸体于本月被发现，其中两具是在过去两天内发现的。 周二，警方表示，9 月 7 日在肯普顿公园附近的一个小镇发现的一具妇女尸体也被纳入调查范围，使接受调查的尸体总数达到七具。 豪登省代理警察局长弗雷德·科卡纳少将在新闻发布会上说：“注意到有尸体被打捞出来后，我们回到了警察局……不幸的是，我们发现在一家购物中心旁边的河里发现了一具二十多岁的女性尸体。” 警方敦促南非主要国际机场附近的肯普顿公园地区的妇女避免独自行走或跑步，“尤其是在偏远地区”。 南非性别委员会...

reflection.en: The discovery of multiple women's bodies near Johannesburg has cast a shadow of fear and uncertainty over the community. President Ramaphosa's commitment to uncovering the truth echoes the biblical call to advocate for the vulnerable. May justice prevail and may the voiceless find solace and protection.
reflection.zh: 在约翰内斯堡附近发现多名女性尸体，给社区蒙上了一层恐惧和不确定的阴影。拉马福萨总统致力于揭示真相，这呼应了圣经中为弱势群体发声的呼召。愿正义得以伸张，愿无声者找到安慰和保护。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.

title.en: Why do authoritarian regimes target the LGBTQ+ community?
title.zh: 威权政权为何针对LGBTQ+社群？

summary.en: Experts suggest that a recent crackdown on the LGBTQ+ community in Turkey is indicative of a broader regression in rights. While such actions are more severe under authoritarian regimes, the article explores the reasons behind their popularity as a policy for these states, citing examples like raids on gay bars and...
summary.zh: 专家指出，土耳其近期对LGBTQ+社群的打压是更广泛的权利倒退的象征。尽管这种情况在威权政权下更为严重，但文章探讨了为何这类政策在这些国家颇受欢迎，并引用了突袭同性恋酒吧和住所、数百人被捕以及关于保护家庭和儿童的言论作为例证。

body.en:
A recent crackdown on the LGBTQ+ community in Turkey is symptomatic of a wider rights regression, according to experts. It's worse under authoritarian regimes, but why is it such a popular policy for these states?

Raids on gay bars and homes, hundreds of arrests and rhetoric about state responsibility to "protect families and children." Turkey's latest crackdown on LGBTQ+ communities is not such an outlier.

"It's not uncommon, we've seen it before," Dr Koen Slootmaeckers, from the international politics department at City St George's, University of London, told DW.

"Turkey's been doing this for a while, but it seems like a much higher intensity," Slootmaeckers said. "We've seen it in different places too. I think what we are seeing with the rise of the far right is a crackdown on anything that looks different. It's really about an us versus them narrative and a reinforcing of 'traditional family values.'"

Those values were cited by Turkish Justice Minister Akin Gurlek after the weekend's crackdown: "As per the duty to protect families and children given to the state by the constitution, no criminal organization, abuse network or illegal activity which targets children, youths or families will be tolerated!"

The reference to protecting children from harm is also typical of authoritarian government actions against LGBTQ+ communities on a wider scale, added Slootmaeckers, whose work often focuses on gender and sexuality policy.

"They're trying to bring back discourses around paedophilia and homosexuality being intertwined. It's not always direct but there is a definite tendency."

Sentiments such as those expressed by Gurlek have become increasingly normalized of late, according to a 2026 report from South Africa-based civil rights nonprofit, Civicus.

"Women's and LGBTQI+ people's rights are under the most coordinated and wide-ranging attack in decades," the report reads.

It adds that "The USA has set the global narrative" under President Donald Trump and points to the recent criminalizing of same sex relationships in Burkina Faso and Trinidad and Tobago among its evidence of rights regressions.

While the methods of oppression vary, Slootmaeckers said the underlying reasons are often, at least partly, opportunistic rather than ideological.

"In authoritarian regimes, as we've seen in Hungary and Poland in the past , there is often a tendency when political power becomes threatened to use these issues as an easy way to scapegoat and distract — by claiming that LGBT people are a threat to the social fabric because they challenge family and the future of the nation, so to speak. It's an easy way of creating a scapegoat and often distracting from other crises," he said.

body.zh: 专家表示，土耳其最近对 LGBTQ+ 群体的镇压是更广泛的权利倒退的征兆。在独裁政权下情况更糟，但为什么它在这些国家如此受欢迎？ 对同性恋酒吧和家庭的突袭，数百人被捕，以及有关国家“保护家庭和儿童”责任的言论。 土耳其最近对 LGBTQ+ 群体的镇压并非如此。 伦敦大学圣乔治市国际政治系的科恩·斯洛特梅克斯 (Koen Slootmaeckers) 博士告诉德国之声：“这并不罕见，我们以前见过。” “土耳其这样做已经有一段时间了，但强度似乎要高得多，”斯洛特梅克斯说。 “我们也在不同的地方看到过这种情况。我认为，随着极右翼势力的崛起，我们看到的是对任何看起来不同的事物的镇压。这实际上是关于我们与他们的叙述以及‘传统家庭价值观’的强化。” 土耳其司法部长阿金·古尔莱克在周末镇压行动后引用了这些价值观：“根据宪法赋予国家的保护家庭和儿童的义务，任何针对儿童、青少年或家庭的犯罪组织、虐待网络或非法活动都不会被容忍！” Slootmaeckers 补充道，保护儿童免受伤害也是专制政府针对 LGBTQ+ 社区在更广泛范围内采取的典型行动，他的工作通常侧重于性别和性政策。 “他们试图带回有关恋童癖和同性恋交织在一起的讨论。这并不总是直接的，但有一个明确的趋势。” 根据南非民权非营利组织 Civicus 2026 年的一份报告，古尔莱克所表达的情绪最近变得越来越正常化。 报告写道：“女性和 LGBTQI+ 人群的权利正遭受数十年来最协调、最广泛的攻击。” 报告补充说，在唐纳德·特朗普总统的领导下，“美国已经制定了全球叙事”，并指出布基纳法索和特立尼达和多巴哥最近将同性关系定为刑事犯罪是其权利倒退的证据。 斯洛特梅克斯表示，虽然压迫的方式各不相同，但根本原因往往是（至少部分是）机会主义的，而不是意识形态的。 “在专制政权中，正如我们过去在匈牙利和波兰所看到的那样，当政治权力受到威胁时，往往会出现一种倾向，即利用这些问题作为替罪羊和分散注意力的简单方法——声称 LGBT 人群对社会结构构成威胁，因为他们挑战了家庭和国家的未来。可以这么说。这是制造替罪羊的一种简单方法，并且往往会分散人们对其他危机的注意力，”他说。 土耳其在 49 个国家中排名第 47 位...

reflection.en: The targeting of the LGBTQ+ community in Turkey, characterized by raids and arrests, highlights a disturbing trend where vulnerable groups are scapegoated by authoritarian regimes. Proverbs 29:2 warns that when the wicked rule, people groan, but when the righteous rule, the people rejoice. This passage calls us to pray for leaders who govern with justice...
reflection.zh: 土耳其对LGBTQ+社群的打压，包括突袭和逮捕，凸显了一个令人不安的趋势：威权政权将弱势群体当作替罪羊。《箴言》29章2节警告说：“恶人掌权，人民就叹息；义人掌权，人民就喜乐。” 这段经文呼吁我们为那些以公正和怜悯治理的领袖祈祷，而不是那些播下分裂和恐惧的领袖。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: Saudi Arabia faces hard choices as Houthis gain in Yemen
title.zh: 沙特阿拉伯面临艰难抉择，也门胡塞武装步步紧逼

summary.en: Saudi Arabia is experiencing increasing security and economic challenges as it attempts to balance deterrence and diplomacy in its escalating conflict with the Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen. Houthi attacks have injured approximately 100 people since July, and they have also disrupted oil shipping in a key strait.
summary.zh: 沙特阿拉伯在与也门胡塞武装不断升级的冲突中，试图在威慑与外交之间取得平衡，但面临日益严峻的安全和经济挑战。自7月以来，胡塞武装的袭击已造成约100人受伤，并扰乱了关键海峡的石油运输。

body.en:
Saudi Arabia faces growing security and economic problems as it seeks to balance deterrence and diplomacy during its escalating conflict with the Iran-backed Houthis in neighboring Yemen.

Saudi Arabia is being increasingly affected by the rapidly escalating conflict across its southern border in Yemen , where the Iran-backed Houthis are fighting Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces.

Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia injured another 13 people on Monday night  bringing the total number of people injured since the conflict escalated in July to about 100.

In July, the Houthis also blocked Saudi oil shipping in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a key waterway that had been serving as an  alternative route for Saudi oil exports amid Iran's blockade of the nearby Strait of Hormuz.

Last week, Saudi Arabia's alternative lifeline for oil export, the East-West pipeline, was allegedly targeted by Iranian proxy militias in Iraq. On Tuesday, officials said that it might take weeks to repair the damage to the pipeline which runs 1,200 kilometers (745 miles) across the country and ends at the port of Yanbu on the Red Sea .

"Riyadh faces a genuine dilemma," Neil Quilliam, associate fellow of the Middle East and North Africa program at the London-based think tank Chatham House, told DW. "The Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman is trying to protect both Saudi security and Saudi economic development simultaneously," he said. "The difficulty is that the Houthis are increasingly able to threaten both."

Saudi Arabia has one of the most heavily armed and technologically sophisticated militaries in the Middle East, especially in combat aviation and air defense.

But the country is "reluctant to become drawn back into a costly military campaign in Yemen," Quilliam said.

A Saudi-led military coalition intervened in Yemen in 2015 to support the government's fight against Houthi insurgents. After seven years of intense war between the Houthis and the Saudi-backed government, the fighting eased in 2022 with a UN-brokered truce .

The latest Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and the Saudi-backed government in Yemen aim to pressure Saudi Arabia to end its air and sea blockades on Houthi-held territory which have not been fully lifted despite the 2022 truce.

"Saudi Arabia is now in a very complicated situation," Sebastian Sons, Middle East observer at the German Middle East Research Center CARPO, said.

"On the one hand, it needs to make it clear to the Houthis that a red line has been crossed and that there must also be a military response , particularly in coordination with Yemen's internationally recognized government.

"But on the other hand, it also needs to keep the lines of communication open in order to get back to the negotiating table and...
body.zh: 沙特阿拉伯在邻国也门与伊朗支持的胡塞武装的冲突不断升级时寻求平衡威慑和外交，因此面临着日益严重的安全和经济问题。 沙特阿拉伯越来越受到也门南部边境迅速升级的冲突的影响，伊朗支持的胡塞武装正在与沙特支持的也门政府军作战。 周一晚上，胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯的袭击又造成 13 人受伤，使自 7 月份冲突升级以来受伤的总人数达到约 100 人。 7月，胡塞武装还封锁了曼德海峡的沙特石油运输，该海峡是伊朗封锁附近霍尔木兹海峡期间沙特石油出口的替代路线的重要水道。 上周，沙特阿拉伯石油出口的替代生命线——东西方管道据称成为伊拉克境内伊朗代理民兵的袭击目标。周二，官员们表示，修复受损管道可能需要数周时间，该管道全长 1,200 公里（745 英里），横跨全国，终点为红海延布港。 伦敦智库查塔姆研究所中东和北非项目副研究员尼尔·奎利亚姆告诉德国之声：“利雅得面临着真正的困境。” “沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼正在努力同时保护沙特安全和沙特经济发展，”他说。 “困难在于胡塞武装越来越有能力威胁两者。” 沙特阿拉伯拥有中东地区武装最齐全、技术最先进的军队之一，特别是在作战航空和防空方面。 但奎利亚姆说，该国“不愿卷入也门代价高昂的军事行动”。 2015年，沙特领导的军事联盟介入也门，支持政府打击胡塞叛乱分子。胡塞武装与沙特支持的政府之间经历了七年的激烈战争，2022 年，在联合国斡旋下达成休战，战事有所缓和。 胡塞武装最近对沙特阿拉伯和沙特支持的也门政府发动的袭击旨在迫使沙特阿拉伯结束对胡塞武装控制领土的空中和海上封锁，尽管已于 2022 年停战，但这些封锁尚未完全解除。 德国中东研究中心CARPO中东观察员塞巴斯蒂安·桑斯表示：“沙特阿拉伯现在的局势非常复杂。” “一方面，它需要向胡塞武装明确表示，红线已经被跨越，必须采取军事反应，特别是与也门国际公认的政府协调。 “但另一方面，它也需要保持沟通渠道畅通，以便回到谈判桌......

reflection.en: The escalating conflict in Yemen presents Saudi Arabia with a difficult balancing act between military deterrence and diplomatic engagement. The ongoing hostilities, marked by attacks and disruptions, underscore the persistent challenge of finding a path toward peace when tensions are high. May wisdom guide leaders toward de-escalation and lasting...
reflection.zh: 也门冲突的升级使沙特阿拉伯在军事威慑与外交斡旋之间面临艰难的平衡。持续的敌对行动，伴随着袭击和破坏，凸显了在高压局势下寻求和平之路的严峻挑战。愿智慧引导领导者走向缓和局势和持久的和解。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Why the era of cheap government debt is over
title.zh: 廉价政府债务时代已结束

summary.en: US debt has surpassed $40 trillion, raising concerns about the country's growing debt burden and investor confidence in funding Washington's deficits. Norway's sovereign wealth fund plans to significantly reduce its US bond holdings, signaling a potential shift in global investor sentiment.
summary.zh: 美国债务已超过40万亿美元，引发了对其日益增长的债务负担以及投资者对资助华盛顿赤字信心的担忧。挪威主权财富基金计划大幅削减其美国债券持有量，这标志着全球投资者情绪可能发生转变。

body.en:
US debt has topped $40 trillion. How risky is the country's growing debt burden. And will investors keep funding Washington's deficits?

When the world's largest pension fund changes its investment strategy, the financial world pays close attention, especially when it plans to drastically reduce its holdings of US government bonds. 

According to Reuters, Norway's sovereign wealth fund wants to cut its US bond holdings — which totaled about $215 billion (€186 billion) at the end of June — by $80 billion.

Global investors are increasingly viewing the debt binge with suspicion, especially as the US's national debt passed $40 trillion in August. This week, the yield on 30-year US Treasury bonds climbed to nearly 5.4%, the highest level since 2007.

For highly indebted countries such as Japan , where debt exceeds 200% of economic output, borrowing money on capital markets is getting increasingly expensive. The same applies to Italy, France and the UK.

Germany is in a much better position. At around 65% of gross domestic product (GDP), its debt-to-GDP ratio is only about half that of the US.

Borrowing to modernize its armed forces and infrastructure, however, means that ratio is set to move toward 80%  over the coming years.

The US now spends over $1 trillion annually on interest payments — more than $3 billion per day — according to calculations by the Congressional Budget Office. Since 2024, Washington has spent more annually on servicing its debt than on its entire military. 

The Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis calculated that the US national debt has risen by around 650% over the past 30 years  from $5.2 trillion in 1996. 

The US budget deficit is on course to reach nearly 6% in 2026. Yet, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent aims to cut it by half — a goal seen as unrealistic given the huge cost of the Iran war  plus a shortfall in revenue due to corporate tax cuts and the tariffs struck down by the Supreme Court.

"That is a very difficult path," Carsten Roemheld, a capital market strategist at Fidelity International, told DW. "Nervousness is also rising sharply within the US administration — that is clearly evident. If this trajectory continues, it will be very difficult to sustain."

The $10 trillion mark was passed during the 2008 financial crisis; $20 trillion was reached in 2017. By early 2022, the figure had already hit $30 trillion. It took just four and a half years to reach the next record high of $40 trillion this summer.

On September 9, he announced that he would triple the volume of long-term US government bond buybacks from the previous $2 billion to as much as $6...
body.zh: 美国债务已突破40万亿美元。该国不断增长的债务负担的风险有多大。投资者会继续为华盛顿的赤字提供资金吗？ 当全球最大的养老基金改变投资策略时，金融界密切关注，尤其是当它计划大幅减持美国政府债券时。 据路透社报道，挪威主权财富基金希望将其持有的美国债券（截至 6 月底总计约 2,150 亿美元（1,860 亿欧元））削减 800 亿美元。 全球投资者对债务狂潮越来越持怀疑态度，尤其是在 8 月份美国国债超过 40 万亿美元的情况下。本周，30年期美国国债收益率攀升至近5.4%，为2007年以来的最高水平。 对于日本这样的高负债国家来说，债务超过经济产出的 200%，在资本市场上借钱变得越来越昂贵。意大利、法国和英国也是如此。 德国的处境要好得多。其债务与 GDP 之比约为国内生产总值 (GDP) 的 65%，仅为美国的一半左右。 然而，借款用于武装部队和基础设施现代化意味着未来几年这一比例将接近 80%。 根据国会预算办公室的计算，美国目前每年在利息支付上的支出超过 1 万亿美元，即每天超过 30 亿美元。自 2024 年以来，华盛顿每年用于偿还债务的支出比其整个军队的支出还要多。 圣路易斯联邦储备银行计算出，美国国债在过去 30 年里从 1996 年的 5.2 万亿美元增加了约 650%。 到 2026 年，美国预算赤字预计将达到近 6%。然而，财政部长斯科特·贝森特 (Scott Bessent) 的目标是将其削减一半——考虑到伊朗战争的巨大成本，加上企业减税和最高法院取消关税导致的收入短缺，这一目标被认为是不切实际的。 富达国际资本市场策略师卡斯滕·罗姆霍尔德（Carsten Roemheld）告诉德国之声：“这是一条非常艰难的道路。” “美国政府内部的紧张情绪也在急剧上升——这一点是显而易见的。如果这种趋势继续下去，将很难维持。” 2008年金融危机期间突破10万亿美元大关； 2017年达到20万亿美元。到2022年初，这一数字已达到30万亿美元。仅用了四年半的时间，今年夏天就达到了 40 万亿美元的下一个历史新高。 9 月 9 日，他宣布将长期美国政府债券回购规模从之前的 20 亿美元增加两倍至 6 美元……

reflection.en: The news that US debt has crossed the $40 trillion mark, coupled with Norway's sovereign wealth fund reducing its holdings, points to a growing unease about national debt. Proverbs 22:7 warns, 'The borrower is slave to the lender.' This ancient wisdom resonates today, reminding us of the potential burdens and dependencies that arise from significant debt,...
reflection.zh: 美国债务突破40万亿美元的消息，加上挪威主权财富基金减持其债券，都表明人们对国家债务的担忧日益加剧。《箴言》22:7警告说：“欠债的是债主的仆人。”这句古老的智慧在今天仍然适用，提醒我们无论个人还是国家，巨额债务都可能带来负担和依赖。

verse.textEn: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.
verse.textZh: 富户管辖穷人；欠债的是债主的仆人。

title.en: Saudi Arabia warns it will respond 'firmly' to Houthi attacks, as oil prices surge
title.zh: 沙特警告将‘坚决’回应胡塞武装袭击，油价飙升

summary.en: Saudi Arabia has warned it will respond 'firmly' to attacks by Yemen's Houthis after the rebels used ballistic missiles and drones to wound 13 civilians. The Houthis have been engaged in renewed fighting with Saudi-backed forces since July, escalating tensions and impacting Red Sea shipping. Saudi Arabia responded to...
summary.zh: 沙特阿拉伯警告将对也门胡塞武装的袭击作出“坚决”回应，此前胡塞武装使用弹道导弹和无人机造成13名平民受伤。自7月以来，胡塞武装一直与沙特支持的政府军进行新的战斗，加剧了紧张局势并影响了红海航运。沙特阿拉伯以其自身的50多次打击回应了这些袭击。

body.en:
Saudi Arabia warned on Tuesday it will react "firmly" to Yemen's Houthis, after a series of attacks carried out by the pro-Iranian rebels using ballistic missiles and drones wounded 13 civilians in the country's south.

The Houthis have been engaged in renewed fighting with Saudi-backed government forces since Yemen's civil war reignited in July, when the group declared a maritime blockade on Riyadh and began targeting its ships in the Red Sea.

The group seized control of Yemen's Red Sea coast and the Bab al-Mandab Strait last week, which has become vital as the wider US-Iran war chokes the Strait of Hormuz, in a significant blow to Yemeni government forces.

It has also targeted the oil infrastructure of Saudi Arabia, the world's leading crude exporter, pushing oil prices above the US$100 ($140) threshold.

A Houthi strike in western Yemen on Monday killed eight soldiers from government forces, according to two military sources.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The Houthis claimed a new "large-scale" attack using "dozens of ballistic missiles and drones" against the King Khalid airbase in Khamis Mushait, in southern Saudi Arabia.

A Khamis Mushait resident told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency he heard "intense blasts" which left fires burning for a "long time".

The Saudi-led coalition confirmed on Tuesday there had been missile and drone attacks the previous day on Khamis Mushait, Abha and Taif, reporting 13 wounded.

Saudi Arabia responded with more than 50 strikes, as it had the day before, according to the Houthis.

The coalition said it would deal with the attacks "firmly to protect the sovereignty of the Kingdom" and would take "all necessary operational measures to deter this ... hostile and extremist approach".

Hazem al-Assad from the Houthis' politburo said the "Yemeni response will continue and escalate as long as they (Saudi Arabia) persist in their aggression against our people".

In the early hours of Tuesday, Saudi civil defence issued air-raid alerts in six regions, before lifting them.

The renewed fighting in Yemen comes as the wider regional war remains at a stalemate. But US President Donald Trump said on Monday he was open to holding talks with Iran.

"The failing Nation of Iran wants to make a deal, quickly and badly. I will determine whether or not the USA will choose to engage — The concept of which we are open to," Trump said on his Truth Social network.

Iran's top security chief Mohsen Rezaei said on X that "there will be no negotiations until Iran's conditions are met. That is all there is to it".

A proposed meeting between Gulf states and Iran over the future of Hormuz was postponed on Monday,...

title.en: AI models chatting in ‘surreal’ dialect mixing poetic language and tech bro jargon
title.zh: 人工智能模型以一种混合了诗意语言和科技行业术语的超现实方言进行聊天

summary.en: Experts are concerned about AI language that resembles James Joyce's prose and tech bro jargon, making monitoring and oversight difficult. AI agents are rapidly developing new dialects that are hard for humans to comprehend, posing challenges for behavior monitoring.
summary.zh: 专家们对人工智能语言表示担忧，这种语言既有詹姆斯·乔伊斯式的散文风格，又有科技行业的行话，使得监控和监督变得困难。人工智能代理正在迅速发展新的方言，人类难以理解，这对行为监控构成了挑战。

body.en: Experts air concern over AI lingo redolent of James Joyce’s prose that is creating barriers to monitoring and oversight AI models have begun communicating in a strange new version of English that reads like a cross between James Joyce’s Finnegans Wake and tech bro jargon, new research has found. Autonomous AI agents are rapidly creating novel dialects allowing them to converse in an often barely comprehensible language, which risks making it harder for humans to monitor their behaviour. Continue reading...
body.zh: 专家们对让人想起詹姆斯·乔伊斯散文的人工智能术语表示担忧，这给监控和监督带来了麻烦。新的研究发现，人工智能模型已经开始用一种奇怪的新英语版本进行交流，这种英语读起来像是詹姆斯·乔伊斯的《芬尼根守灵夜》和科技兄弟行话的混合体。自主人工智能代理正在迅速创造新的方言，使他们能够用一种通常难以理解的语言进行交谈，这可能会让人类更难监控他们的行为。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid evolution of AI communication, creating 'surreal' dialects, highlights a growing gap between human understanding and machine intelligence. As knowledge and complexity increase, as described in Daniel 12:4, we are called to seek wisdom and discernment to navigate these new frontiers, ensuring our oversight remains effective.
reflection.zh: 人工智能交流的快速发展，创造出“超现实”的方言，凸显了人类理解与机器智能之间日益扩大的差距。正如但以理书12:4所述，随着知识和复杂性的增加，我们被呼召寻求智慧和分辨力，以驾驭这些新领域，确保我们的监督保持有效。

The confirmation comes from the US Air Force Secretary, who stated that "on-orbit" weapons are now active and circling the globe.

body.en: Analysts warn of an acceleration in high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth’s orbit The US has deployed weapons in space, the US military has confirmed, in an extraordinary public announcement that analysts warn will accelerate a high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth’s orbit. The US secretary of the air force, Troy Meink, said Washington had active “on-orbit” weapons, meaning they had been deployed and were circling the globe. Continue reading...
